name: הסתברות למדעי המחשב 2026 מועד א — multiple-choice-only
answer_sheet_description: psychometric-style response table: one row per question (1-10), option columns א/ב/ג/ד with a small checkbox in each cell; the student marks one box per row (X, checkmark, or filled)
policy_evidence: The sheet itself prints 'סמנו כאן בלבד! אין לסמן תשובות בגוף הבחינה' (mark HERE only; do not mark answers in the exam body) — first page of every scan and of sol.pdf.
notes: Template-specific rule per the teaching assistant: the first page is the authoritative answer sheet; circles/calculations on the later question pages are scratch work and must never override the table. Question pages are used only for structure (variant option orderings) — captured one-time in sol.answer_key.json.
